channel.title: FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) Robots on Aarush Mane
channel.description: Recent content in FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) Robots on Aarush Mane

item.title: Medusa | 2026 FRC Robot
item.description: Oculus Quest coprocessor localization, 3D pose tracking, autonomous scheduling, and analytics for Team 2590’s Medusa robot, which earned the 2026 Innovation in Control Award.

item.title: Leonidas | 2025 FRC Robot
item.description: Vision, swerve autonomy, trajectory following, and simulation work for Team 2590’s Leonidas robot, which won 2025 FMA Robbinsville robot performance.

item.title: Kronos | 2024 FRC Robot
item.description: Java command-based software, PathPlanner routines, and vision tools for Team 2590’s Kronos robot, which won its Championship Division at Worlds.
